Every one of us knows someone whose life has been touched by cancer. I know it personally. And I also know that we are closer than ever to making real progress — if we choose to focus our efforts. That’s why we are launching this initiative: to double the rate of progress, to break down the barriers between researchers, and to share data so that discoveries reach patients faster. We need the best minds in government, in universities, in industry, and in patient communities working side by side. We’ll fund new trials, speed up the review of promising therapies, and make sure that what we learn is available to everyone. This is a moonshot, yes, but it is also a promise: that we will not stop until we have done everything we can.
